hook.text: Aardman deliberately leaves fingerprints visible in their clay. The imperfections are the point.

buildup.text: In a world of flawless CGI, Aardman's films feel warm and human because you can see the handwork.

discovery.text: Audiences respond to the tactile quality. Knowing real hands shaped every frame creates emotional warmth.

twist.text: Some studios have tried to digitally smooth clay imperfections. Aardman considers this a betrayal.

climax.text: Aardman's refusal to hide the human touch has become its greatest competitive advantage.

punchline.text: Fingerprints in clay became Aardman's signature.

quiz.question: Why does Aardman leave fingerprints visible in their clay animation?
options: They lack the technology to remove them
The visible handwork creates warmth and humanity that distinguishes their films from CGI
It is required by British animation regulations
